say:2:1536118501:1.text: When the warriors return from the Bloodhunt, we'll hold a grand feast right here.
say:2:1536118501:1.source_cn: 等猎血节的勇士归来，这里就会举办盛大的欢庆仪式。
say:2:1536118501:1.male: When the warriors return from the Bloodhunt, we'll hold a grand feast right here.
say:2:1536118501:1.female: When the warriors return from the Bloodhunt, we'll hold a grand feast right here.

say:3:1536118502:1.text: We're getting the food and wine ready. Modra says only the finest will do for the feast.
say:3:1536118502:1.source_cn: 我们在准备仪式用的食材和密酿，蒙多说要用最好的品质。
